title: Cylinder Calculator
description: Enter radius and height to get cylinder volume, lateral surface area and total surface area.
howto: Type the radius and the height.
Read the volume, lateral area and total surface area with formulas.

faqs.a: Lateral is just the curved side (2πrh); total adds the two circular bases.
The base area πr² stacked h units high gives the volume.

faqs.q: Does it work for hollow tubes?
faqs.a: No — this is a solid cylinder. Subtract an inner cylinder’s volume for a tube.
